intent: Contain keyboard focus inside the already-adopted shared Quick Settings aria-modal while preserving existing settings authority, outside/Escape dismissal, and trigger focus return.
acceptance: Tab from the last modal focusable wraps to the first.
Shift+Tab from the first modal focusable wraps to the last.
If focus is outside the open modal, Tab or Shift+Tab re-enters the modal instead of advancing through the underlay.
Tab between interior modal controls remains native and is not unnecessarily prevented.
Existing outside click, Escape close, trigger focus return, and Settings proxy semantics remain unchanged.
rollback: Revert the branch commits; no save, gameplay, rule, economy, network, or data schema migration is introduced.
